tiles: Four corner crops, each covering ceil(0.6*width) by ceil(0.6*height), with 20% full-image overlap on each axis; use RF-DETR's unchanged 704-square processor.
merge: Preserve all accepted YOLO boxes. Append nonoverlapping native RF boxes, then nonoverlapping tiled RF boxes, suppressing new boxes at IoU >=0.5 with an already retained box. Never move or replace retained boxes.
score: Fit one monotone class-balanced logit-evidence mapping per raw branch on development detections only; sigmoid mapped evidence gives a common nominal balanced prior for ranking. This is not a deployment probability.
selection: Compare frozen calibrated YOLO, native RF, their preserving union, and preserving unions with each tile threshold on development. Select maximum point F1; require precision >=calibrated YOLO, recall >=native RF and small-ball recall >=calibrated YOLO. Ties retain fewer branches, then higher tile threshold. No possession promotion from this component test alone.
fresh_test: Use Open Images official test split. Exclude all prior pilot photo identities and authors and all COCO 2017 train/validation photo identities. No reuse of the opened six-ball pilot for metrics or candidate selection. Freeze selected method before new test detector metrics.
